translations.overview: Un simpatico contrabbandiere scommette con due ricconi di riuscire a trasportare 400 casse di birra dal Texas in Georgia in 28 ore tra peripezie e disavventure con la polizia.
A race car driver tries to transport an illegal beer shipment from Texas to Atlanta in under 28 hours, picking up a reluctant bride-to-be on the way.
translations.tagline: "What we have here is a total lack of respect for the law!"
